claim.value: Separate logs may share clock errors, so their separation does not guarantee independent evidence.
claim.scope: A possible common-error mechanism, not a finding that clock errors occurred in these logs.

provenance.rationale: P028 explicitly identifies shared clock errors as a possible limitation on the independence of separate logs.

signal_basis.value: Compare agreement or disagreement about the same booking and handoff while assessing source access and copying; separate records may share clock errors.
signal_basis.scope: Assessment of whether corroborating records provide independent evidence, without asserting that a shared error actually occurred.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the source assessment, comparison signal and explicit common-error qualification.
The bounded possibility claim is supported without establishing an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Distinct logs can derive timestamps from the same faulty clock, making their errors dependent despite their separation. Agreement therefore does not guarantee independent evidence. The claim asserts only this possibility.
uncertainty: Whether these particular logs actually share clock errors remains unknown and is outside the claim.
